key_points: FTC and USDA have opened an inquiry into farm equipment market practices, affecting CAT and peers.
CAT shares fell ~6% on Oct 7-8 amid the inquiry and a broader industrials selloff with rising Treasury yields.
Analysts note valuation concerns and question the sustainability of the backlog after a strong run.
Q3 earnings outlook is described as constructive by some analysts, with no earnings surprise reported.
Market reaction appears driven primarily by regulatory risk rather than fundamental deterioration.
